infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sakhi shares your location with the police stations that cover your area and with the trusted contacts you have added, but only while an emergency you started is running.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: So your location keeps reaching responders if your screen locks or you switch apps during an emergency. It is never tracked when no emergency is active.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: At Level 2 and above, Sakhi records ambient audio as evidence and uploads it to private storage that only the responding officers can open. Recording stops the moment the emergency ends.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Sakhi watches the motion sensor so a hard shake can trigger an alert when you cannot reach the screen. You can turn this off in Safety Settings.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Sakhi shares your location with responders only while an emergency is active.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Sakhi needs your location to work out which police station covers you when you trigger an alert.

plugins.microphonePermission: At Level 2 and above, Sakhi records ambient audio as evidence for the responding officers.
